notes.title: The Gravity Trickster Demo
notes.notes:
[h2]Join me for the Live Stream, where I play through the demo version of my solo developed game, The Gravity Trickster, a 3D puzzle platformer.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837083/cd6147de37c60f72bc83344ec3754987c0cb3917.png[/img]
[h3]Ask me anything during the stream.[/h3]

[h3]Visit to website and feel free to reach out later if you missed the Stream:[/h3]
[url=https://thegravitytrickster.com/]https://thegravitytrickster.com/[/url]
[h3]For latest new, check The Gravity Trickster on Social Media:[/h3]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/TheGravityTrickster]Facebook[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837083/90e68fe11f6fc8ceea5dfbed9ec63fae4b0b230d.png[/img]

[h2]The full version will be available on Steam this July![/h2]
